text:
ana: Heads-up — dashboard shows a huge inbound spike the day after the Benchmark webinar (+320% YoY for that day), but the attribution table only lists 40 leads credited to the webinar campaign. Link: https://app.redwood.ai/dash/benchmarks/weekly

brian: Hmm that smells like a sampling or UTM mismatch. Which metric are you looking at? sessions? signups?

ana: sorry typo — signups. The chart is signups by source. The attribution table is last_touch by campaign.

chloe: We changed the launch post UTMs mid-week for A/B copy. Some posts used campaign=bench-v2 and some campaign=bench-launch. Could be split across both and last-touch only points to one.

dave: Also worth checking the ingestion pipeline — zapier -> crm sometimes strips query params on redirect. I saw that once for demos. Quick raw check SQL:```SELECT event_time, utm_source, utm_campaign, email FROM inbound_webhooks WHERE event_time >= '2025-11-05' AND event_time < '2025-11-07' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200;```

brian: Good call. Evan, can analytics re-run a multi-touch attribution and raw webhook join? Also check sample_rate on the GA export — we had a sampling toggle last quarter to reduce BigQuery costs.

evan-analytics-bot: Confirmed — GA export sampling was enabled at 10% on 2025-10-31 and disabled 2025-11-08. Running a multi-touch attribution (linear) and raw event join now. ETA ~ 45m.

chloe: If zapier is dropping UTMs we should treat those as "direct" in last-touch, which could explain the discrepancy. Also note campaign naming inconsistency: bench-v2 vs bench-launch. Need a mapping table.

ana: For the KPI review tomorrow can we have: 1) multi-touch vs last-touch comparison, 2) raw webhook join to verify UTMs, 3) a small cohort of signups with full referrer chain.

brian: I'll re-run the dashboard with campaign normalization (map bench-v2 -> benchmark-webinar). Also will apply a sample-rate correction factor to the GA-derived numbers.

dave: Quick ops note — if Zapier is the culprit we can add a tiny snippet to the redirect to preserve querystring: `window.location.replace(url + (url.indexOf('?')===-1? '?'+qs : '&'+qs))` until we fix the Zap.

evan-analytics-bot: Multi-touch v last-touch comparison complete: multi-touch credits 312 leads to the normalized webinar campaign for 11/6 window, last-touch shows 41. Raw webhook join found 298 events with utm_campaign in {"bench-v2","bench-launch","benchmark-webinar"}. Full csv export uploaded: gs://redwood-analytics/exports/2025-11-06-webinar-attr.csv

chloe: That alignment looks much better — the spike is real, just fragmented. I'll update the benchmark narrative to call out that organic amplification + a promo push drove the lift and that attribution undercounted due to naming and pipeline drops.

ana: Awesome. Can we surface a small note on the KPI board: "11/6 webinar uplift adjusted for sampling & UTM normalization = +~300 signups; adjust MQL routing and revenue forecast accordingly"

brian: Done — added to the KPI board and flagged for tomorrow's review. :white_check_mark:

ana: Thanks team, closing this thread. We'll cover in the weekly KPI review and mark any follow-ups in the sprint. :thumbsup:
